scenes.say: On Sunday he scored a point in his first ever F1 race. A week later he was world champion. In another series.
Haas called Ryo Hirakawa up to replace Esteban Ocon in the middle of the Mexico weekend. He started nineteenth.
After the final restart he passed both Williams cars and crossed the line thirteenth.
Then the stewards penalised Piastri, Gasly and Colapinto. Hirakawa moved up to tenth, a point on debut.
A week later at Monza his number eight Toyota just brought it home. That's a third WEC title.
In Las Vegas he's back in the Haas, in first practice instead of Ollie Bearman.
Full results and points are on LapRadar.

title: Ryo Hirakawa: a point in his first F1 race, then a third WEC title a week later
